instruction: Answer-format control for the same case: Give exactly one most likely disorder or related system supported at the final Findings stage. Use a standard diagnostic name at the level of specificity justified by the available evidence. Do not provide a differential list, alternatives, or an unsupported subtype. Put only that single name inside \boxed{}.
exposure: Previously frozen validation47 is now exposed development. No new holdout.
interpretation: The native task permits plural impressions; single-answer selection is an interface attribution control, not equivalent native ASCENT evaluation.
worker: Reuse previous direct_worker unchanged with output directory rebound locally; original model and temperature0.7/top_p1/top_k-1/seed42/max_tokens2048/batch8; eager and fixed2048KV. Total-card memory budget reduced from0.95 to0.45 for co-resident workers; not a decoding change.

alias_and_multiple_answer_protocol: No new alias mapping or gold-specific extraction. Complete extracted answers, including lists, go through the same frozen scorer. Lexical variants, same-identity descriptors, multiple impressions, granularity/system answers, and another disease are reviewed separately as explanatory categories only. Target presence and human semantic categories are not medical accuracy or official F1.
official_evaluation: Author evaluator requires external GPT-4.1, temperature0, five judgments per response, position-wise majority over 1=equivalent/2=too-specific/3=too-broad/4=wrong followed by micro P/R/F1. No faithful local GPT-4.1 backend or existing judgments for these arms; no external API invoked or credential values reported, and no authentication check attempted. Thus official score not produced.
